newsitem.title: INDIA: Eleven feared dead as India boat capsizes in storm.
newsitem.headline: Eleven feared dead as India boat capsizes in storm.

text.p: Eleven people were feared drowned after a boat capsized in a storm in India's eastern state of West Bengal, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported on Tuesday.
The news agency quoted police as saying four bodies had been recovered after the incident on Monday in Murshidabad district, 180 km (113 miles) north of the state capital, Calcutta.

The boat was ferrying 70 people across the Ganges river from Nirmalchar, on the border with Bangladesh, to nearby Kuthibari, when a storm arose and the boat capsized, PTI said. It gave no further details.
